cells.gaps: No fact states a connection provided to the commune office: MAR-001 and MAR-006 name the platforms and say outright that the municipalities' connection is not stated, and the only fact on the connection (MAR-015, 2016, a belief with no statistics, about civil registry offices) is `none`, which disagrees with the systems use reported in 2025 and 2026. The authorities facts disagree too: 969 of 1,590 is a deployment of GIR-CT across all tiers in 2020, and the newer figures (over 91, 59 of 97, more than 100) are counts within programmes with no national total of communes. No plan with a period is held, and no dated event falls in the twelve months.
cells.note: Municipalities work in national systems past any pilot and outside the capital (Rokhas in over 91, the revenue system in more than 100), which reaches stage 3 under the study's rule on work in a national system. No fact states how the offices are connected, and no share of communes with its total is given, so no rung above 3 is reached. Restaged from 2 by the parent at L5, for consistency across cells.
